prompt:
A clean line-art blocking diagram of one scene of a live-action short drama, vertical composition: the place of Image 1 drawn in simple black outlines on white, with the segment's people in their places at its start, the way a master shot shows the whole scene before it is cut into shots. Keep Image 1's camera position, framing, walls, windows, doorways and furniture, traced in outline; only add the people.
Image 1: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the front view, with no people
Image 2: the character sheet of Natalie (25), look S1
Image 3: the character sheet of Sebastian (30), look S2
Image 4: the character sheet of George (55), look S1
Image 5: the character sheet of Officiant (58)
Image 6: the character sheet of Cassie (23), look S1
Image 7: the character sheet of Lauren (50), look S1
Image 8: the character sheet of Guest 1 (25)
Image 9: the character sheet of Guest 2 (25)
Draw each person as a clean outline figure that can be told apart by hairstyle, build and the shape of their outfit, from their character sheet; no faces in detail. Do not copy a sheet's layout, white background or multiple views. Each person appears once, whole and at natural scale for the place, on the furniture and floor of Image 1, facing the way the start says.
Only eight people appear: Natalie, Sebastian, George, Officiant, Cassie, Lauren, Guest 1, and Guest 2. Nobody else is there.
At the start: Camera on the aisle in front of the white wooden wedding arch, on the rose-bush side. Natalie, in her ivory bridal gown and short veil, stands under the centre of the arch, holding the one bouquet loosely at her waist and staring at Sebastian. Sebastian, in his black tuxedo, stands beside her under the arch on the boxwood-hedge side, facing her. George, in his charcoal suit, stands beside Natalie under the arch on the rose-bush side, facing down the aisle. The Officiant stands at the centre of the arch just behind the couple, hands clasped, facing down the aisle. Cassie, in her scarlet satin cocktail dress, stands at the head of the aisle a step in front of Natalie on the rose-bush side, holding the one empty white gift box with its lid off. Lauren, in her lilac sheath dress with a small handbag on her arm, stands at the head of the aisle against the front-row chair on the boxwood-hedge side. Two short rows of white folding chairs flank the petal aisle. Natalie's phone lies face up on the seat of the front-row chair on the rose-bush side. On the boxwood-hedge side of the lawn stands one small round white high cocktail table with one silver tray; Guest 1 stands at it on the arch side and Guest 2 on the aisle side, each holding a champagne flute, and Guest 1's pink phone is in the silver clutch under her arm.

No shading, solid black areas, colour or photographic rendering: dark hair and clothes are outlines left white inside; no text, letters, numbers, arrows, labels or watermark.
